title: hotfix: fix race in SLO enforcer causing duplicate regional failover during rapid capacity loss
author: Priya Raman
release_notes: Hotfix: fixes race condition in SLO enforcer that could trigger duplicate regional failover and noisy load-shedding during rapid multi-region capacity loss.
body: Context: During a production incident on 2026-02-18 we observed the SLO enforcer trigger regional failover twice in quick succession when multiple nodes in a primary region restarted, which caused cascading load-shedding and a noisy surge in failover metrics. This PR fixes a race in the enforcer state machine where a failover decision could be re-evaluated concurrently with a state transition, allowing duplicate failovers and aggressive backoff resets. Changes: 1) Introduce a lightweight mutex around the enforcer state transition path to serialize failover decision and state mutation; 2) Consolidate state mutation into a single transition function to reduce interleaving; 3) Add deterministic unit and integration tests that simulate rapid capacity loss across regions and assert a single failover decision and correct backoff behavior; 4) Improve observability: add a dedicated failover_decision_reason and failover_id metric and clearer logging for each decision to make postmortems easier. Testing and rollout: unit tests and integration tests added; ran k8s canary in staging for 6 hours with synthetic failure injection (passed); plan to deploy to canary in prod for 1 hour and then roll to 50% before full rollout. Related work: ENG-3245 tracks the incident and follow-up; SUP-1123 customer ticket that surfaced noisy failovers. This description contains the full motivation, change summary, and rollout plan.
commits: Fix race between cb state transition and failover trigger
Add mutex around enforcer state machine and consolidate transitions
Add deterministic unit test for rapid failover scenario
Improve logging and add failover_id metric
Update docs and runbook with mitigation steps
review_comments: Ethan Cole: Found a potential deadlock if shutdown hooks try to acquire the mutex; suggest using try-lock with graceful fallback. Author reply: switched to a context-aware mutex and added graceful shutdown path.
Marta Li: Can we add a metric for dropped failover attempts to ensure we can track serialization effects? Author reply: added failover_attempt_dropped counter and documented its semantics.

Diego Alvarez: Unit tests look good; integration test reproduces the original failure locally. Approving pending CI flakiness fix. Author reply: fixed a flake by stabilizing timing in the integration harness, re-ran tests.
Ethan Cole: Verified staging canary logs and metrics, looks good. Approving.
ci_checks: integration-tests: pass (initial run failed due to timing flake, re-run passed)
merge_commit_message: hotfix(slo-enforcer): fix race in regional failover state machine (ENG-3245)
notes: This is a hotfix for an incident; small risk due to mutex in critical path but measured latency impact in staging <1ms P95. Observability added to monitor for any increase in failover latency. Ops: if new failover latency exceeds 20ms P95 rollback to previous revision and contact on-call SRE.
user_impact: Previously some customers saw repeated failovers and increased request errors for ~4 minutes during the incident. This fix prevents duplicate failover decisions and reduces noisy load-shedding.
